news.title: New Publication in Adv. Energy Mater.
news.summary: We are pleased to announce that our latest research paper has been accepted for publication in Adv. Energy Mater.. In this work, we develop a structural-feature-constrained generative model for the computational discovery of novel sulfide lithium superionic conductors.

news.title: New Publication in J. Mater. Chem. A
news.summary: We are pleased to announce that our latest research paper has been accepted for publication in J. Mater. Chem. A. In this work, we develop a multi-property evaluation framework to systematically assess lithium- and sodium-based binary compounds as artificial coatings for all-solid-state batteries.

news.title: New Publication in Chem. Sci.
news.summary: We are pleased to announce that our latest research paper has been accepted for publication in Chem. Sci.. In this work, we propose a synergistic multi-anion and cation co-doping strategy to construct a highly amorphous halide electrolyte, enabling fast ion transport and stable interfaces.

news.title: New Publication in ACS Nano
news.summary: We are pleased to announce that our latest research paper has been accepted for publication in ACS Nano.

news.title: The release of GPUMDkit package
news.summary: We are pleased to announce the release of GPUMDkit, a user-friendly toolkit for GPUMD and NEP.

news.title: New Publication in npj Comput. Mater.
news.summary: We are pleased to announce that our latest research paper has been accepted for publication in npj Comput. Mater. Here, we propose a feasible principle toward synthesizing complex inorganic solids.

news.title: New Publication in Sci. Adv.
news.summary: We are pleased to announce that our latest research paper has been accepted for publication in Science Advance. Here, we propose a feasible principle toward synthesizing complex inorganic solids.

news.title: New Publication in Adv. Mater.
news.summary: We are pleased to announce that our latest research paper has been accepted for publication in Advanced Materials. Here, a rational design strategy is introduced to stabilize HE-LLZO by combining thermodynamic assessments of interfacial reactivity with targeted compositional engineering.

news.title: New Publication in JMCA
news.summary: We are pleased to announce that our latest research paper has been accepted for publication in J. Mater. Chem. A. In this work, we propose an approach that directly identifies the polar structure after polarization switching, using the symmetry operations of the framework structure.

news.title: New Publication in Chem. Mater.
news.summary: We are pleased to announce that our latest research paper has been accepted for publication in Chemistry of Materials. In this work, we found that lithium nonstoichiometry in tetragonal Li7La3Zr2O12 significantly reduce the activation energy for Li+ ion diffusion.

news.title: New Member Joining
news.summary: We warmly welcome Boyi Situ joining our group as a Ph.D. student. Boyi received his B.S. degree from Yangzhou University. His research will focus on the discovery of structurally constrained ion conductors using generative models....

news.title: New Publication in ACS Nano
news.summary: Our latest research on high-voltage all-solid-state lithium batteries has been published in ACS Nano. This work demonstrates significant advancements in battery technology through the innovative use of high-valent-element-doped halide electrolytes.

news.title: New Publication in ACS Appl. Energy Mater.
news.summary: We are pleased to announce that our latest research paper titled "Elucidating Anisotropic Ionic Diffusion Mechanism in Li3YCl6 with Molecular Dynamics Simulations" has been published in ACS Applied Energy Materials....
